name: Eric Daugherty
text:
🚨 JUST IN: President Trump says he's open to JENSEN HUANG being put back in as Nvidia CEO

"I would not mind. I would not mind that!"

"I would say that Jensen's reinstatement, I think he learned a big lesson, I guess maybe one lesson more important than another. But I would certainly not mind seeing that."

Elon Musk is backing a "Bring Jensen Back" petition as well

Nvidia has lost about $500 BILLION in value since the scandal broke, and the stock is down more than 30% from its October record
